identity.symptom: better auth endpoints absent from scalar

what: Better Auth endpoints were absent from Scalar, preventing discovery of login before using authenticated todos.
expected: Scalar includes native authentication endpoints and instructions, and browser login enables protected todo requests.
observed: The live application document contained hello and todo operations but no /api/auth/sign-in/email operation.
root_cause: packages/runtime-hono/src/api-docs.ts served only the graph-derived application document. The raw Better Auth catch-all handler did not contribute its native endpoint schemas, and the generated auth runtime supplied session lookup only.
fixed_by: Added lazy native Better Auth schema generation, mounted paths and isolated schema names, merged it into authorized API docs, wired generated and testing auth runtimes, and added same-origin login instructions. Verified browser signup/login and todo CRUD with session cookies.

invariants: Auth schemas describe their real mount
Same-origin browser sessions authenticate todo requests
Unauthenticated and cross-user access stays denied

environment.monitoring: Existing RELKIT HTTP logs and development telemetry. Local request logs confirmed signup/login 200, todo creation 201, CRUD success, denial 401 and missing item 404.

reproduction: Fetch the live OpenAPI document and assert /api/auth/sign-in/email exists.
Open Scalar and submit signup or login using Test Request.
Create and list a todo through Scalar with no manual auth header.
Read the persisted todo, update it, read back the update, delete it, and assert later reads return 404.

after.note: Scalar sign-in, creation, listing and persisted CRUD assertions pass

before.assertion: Authentication operations and schema are merged into the application document

after.command: rtk bun x vitest run packages/better-auth/tests/auth packages/better-auth/tests/openapi.test.ts packages/better-auth/tests/react.test.ts packages/runtime-hono/tests/api-docs-auth.test.ts packages/runtime-hono/tests/api-docs.test.ts packages/runtime-hono/tests/auth.test.ts
after.assertion: Authentication operations and schema are merged into the application document

runtime.boundary: Generated CLI server -> auth activation -> protected OpenAPI document -> native Better Auth schema
steps: Run the demo with its local framework links

e2e.command: rtk agent-browser --session relkit-auth-docs eval '(async()=>{const response=await fetch("/todos");const data=await response.json();const todo=data.todos.find(t=>t.title==="Scalar browser acceptance final");if(!todo)throw Error("Scalar todo was not persisted");const patch=await fetch("/todos/"+todo.id,{method:"PATCH",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({completed:true})});const read=await fetch("/todos/"+todo.id);const stored=await read.json();const deleted=await fetch("/todos/"+todo.id,{method:"DELETE"});const missing=await fetch("/todos/"+todo.id);const result={scalarSignIn:window.scalarChecks.some(x=>x.path==="/api/auth/sign-in/email"&&x.status===200),scalarCreate:window.scalarChecks.some(x=>x.path==="/todos"&&x.status===201),scalarList:window.scalarChecks.some(x=>x.path==="/todos"&&x.status===200),update:patch.status===200,persistedUpdate:stored.completed===true,deleted:deleted.status===200,missing:missing.status===404};if(Object.values(result).some(x=>!x))throw Error(JSON.stringify(result));return result;})()'
e2e.assertion: Scalar login stores the session; todo creation/listing work without copied tokens; updates persist and deletion returns 404

limitations: The existing Phase 0 exports guard fails for an unchanged create-relkit manifest.
The demo uses temporary local dependency links without manifest or lockfile changes; reinstalling dependencies restores published versions.
Existing inspector Playwright fixtures have no Better Auth login scenario; focused browser acceptance used agent-browser against the real demo.

notes: No demo source files were changed. Local links unify the framework and Drizzle package identities.
Native schema generation installs no additional public Better Auth docs endpoints.
Browser request-body editing initially appended JSON; those 400 responses were test-driver errors. Final valid request bodies and all recorded acceptance assertions pass.
No commit, push or release performed.
